::: {#fig-preimage}

```{r}
#| label: preimage-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "The six points of the doubled die roll, at heights 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12.",
  "Horizontal lines at heights 4 and 6 each pass through one point,",
  "at die rolls 2 and 3.",
  "A dashed horizontal line at height 3 passes through no point."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: preimage-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
rolls <- data.frame(roll = 1:6, double = 2 * (1:6))
levels_shown <- data.frame(
  height = c(3, 4, 6),
  hits = c(
    "preimage is empty",
    "preimage contains a roll",
    "preimage contains a roll"
  )
)

preimage_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    data = levels_shown,
    ggplot2::aes(yintercept = height, linetype = hits),
    colour = "#D55E00"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = rolls,
    ggplot2::aes(x = roll, y = double),
    size = 3,
    colour = "#0072B2"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12)) +
  ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "preimage contains a roll" = "solid",
      "preimage is empty" = "dashed"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Input, a (the roll)",
    y = "Output, f(a) = 2a",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(preimage_plot) |>
      plotly::layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
  )
} else {
  preimage_plot
}
```

The [preimage](#def-preimage) of a [set](sets.qmd#def-set) of [values](#def-value) is the set of rolls whose points lie at those heights.
The heights $4$ and $6$ are reached at the rolls $2$ and $3$, so the preimage of $\set{4, 6}$ is $\set{2, 3}$.
The height $3$ is reached by no roll, so its preimage is empty.

:::
